newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle seen steady to up, feeders higher.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle seen steady to up, feeders higher.

text.p: CME live cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent per lb higher while feeder cattle were called 0.100 to 0.200 higher, analysts said.

Carryover demand in live cattle futures was expected following the firmer undertone to cash cattle and fairly large advance in boxed beef values. Packers are showing good interest for cash cattle and fed cattle are expected to trade at $64 per cwt soon, analysts said.
Increased retailer interest boosted boxed beef values $1.58 to $1.82 per cwt.

Feeder futures were also seen showing carryover strength following a stronger cash feeder market and expected further strength in the fed cattle market. Recent active feedlot movement and declining feed lots has kept interest for replacement feeders at feedlots fairly strong, analysts said.
Expectations of lower corn futures and a fairly large jump in the latest CME feeder cattle index should boost futures prices, they added.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was up $0.72 at $77.46 per cwt.
